title: Sinkhole ground-breach genre in Portal Lab
context: The owner intends enemies to breach from the ground and requested an initial effect study using the Monolith Rift import guide. Gameplay spawn replacement is later work.
outcome: Added separate Sinkhole genre with rumble pre-roll, crater fracture and subsidence, radial fissures, dust and debris. Pinned imported source/textures from 364c9ce70ba784809291e87981ca83a19560f73d, retained MIT attribution and adapted to existing Three r160. Monolith clamp permits zero; warp is omitted. Host cuts a real opening in its planar floor and supplies a dark cavity. Reset clears event resources and reuses the ability. Controls remain preview-only; no second export format or game-spawn change.
alternatives: Original negative-heave plate behind an intact floor cannot provide a visible hole; host floor discard and central slab descent are required.
Initial subsidence used the wrong cell coordinate pair and retained too much plate; corrected aCell.xy and inspected the settled browser capture.
No distortion post pass or second Three version introduced.
evidence: node scripts/browser-test.mjs --sinkhole passed texture/shader load, rumble, opening/subsidence, zero monoliths, reset/reopen, return to portals and disposal.
npm run assets:check validates original import provenance and adapted checksums.
docs/SINKHOLE.md documents planar-host boundary and preview-only controls.
